transcript: The highly requested classic sugar cookie that will be your new go-to sugar cookie recipe. These things are so perfect and so easy and I made these ones smaller than my normal cookies so you guys get more out of this batch. First whisk up your dry ingredients and set those aside. Can we talk about how Funky Town is playing in the background? It is your girl's time of the month. She's going through it and I needed this song right now. I don't know why it's making me crack up. It is definitely the little things. As you can see, next cream together your softened butter and sugar. Once that's light and fluffy like so, mix in your egg, egg yolk, and both extracts. Now listen, you can make that almond extract optional but I highly, highly recommend it. In my personal opinion, almond extract makes sugar cookies so much better. Finally fold in your dry ingredients until your dough looks just like so. Wasn't that so easy? I mean honestly, it does not get any easier than this. I really recommend you guys save this one for Christmas. Also, these would be great as a Christmas cookie. I then took my size D24. It says cookie scoop. Guys, I swear I'm not a pro like you think I am but it says D24 because you guys always ask and scooped out 18 cookie balls, rolled them in sugar and baked on 350 for 10 minutes. And no, I did not chill the dough first. If you can eat these while they're still warm, do it. Trust me.
